Vampire Crypts (originally called Vampire Hell by players) is a massive Vampire dungeon below the sands of Drefia. Historically it was nothing more than a small section of the main Drefia dungeon, and although the connection with the main dungeon remains, the Vampire Crypts have their own entrance and have finally been recognized as an independent area (in The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest), since July 2013. To the south-east of the main floors are the Drefia Grim Reaper Dungeons, although the entrance to them has also moved with the revamp of Drefia. The Vampire Crypts also contain the resting location of The Pale Count, a rare boss whose appearance opens up the final two floors of the crypts until he is slain.

Because of the abundance of Vampires, it is advised to bring a Blessed Wooden Stake with you when hunting at the Vampire Crypts. Dusting will make your hunting trip a lot more profitable.

Route

  • Find your way to the northern part of Drefia and go down the main ruin here (32996, 32412, 7).
  • Go down three times and you will appear in the Necromancer Halls. You will have to walk east, then south, then west, and then south again. This can be seen on the following map:







































Browse Map (33012, 32437, 10)
  • Now you have two options to go down, one is a little north of the place you emerged at, and the other is some steps to the west from where you emerged. It doesn't really matter which one you choose, both paths will lead to the floor below. The following map marks the aforementioned holes:






































Browse Map (32998, 32466, 11)
  • Now you have arrived on the first floor of the Vampire Crypts.

The third and fourth floor are only accessible during the raid of The Pale Count.

History

Implemented in the Summer update of 2002, it was a small section known as Vampire Hell. It was expanded and became an independent area in the Summer Update 2013.

Pre Summer Update 2013

It was a tunnel that housed 11 Vampires, 4 Ghosts, around 9 Demon Skeletons, 10 Ghouls, 4 Stalkers, 2 Scorpions and 3 Mummies.
